title: AI Spokesperson Video Maker for Product Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into an AI spokesperson ad. Pick a realistic actor and scene, write one line, and get a talking video in minutes.
h1: Create Spokesperson Videos with Realistic AI Actors
lead: Some products sell once a feature is explained out loud. Pick a realistic AI actor and a scene, write one line, and get a talking ad in minutes. No casting, no studio day.
benefits_h2: Why brands choose spokesperson videos with AIVideosUGC

benefits.d: Get a talking ad in minutes. Skip the casting, the booking and the weeks of prep before a shoot.
Try different actors and hooks with the same product photo. Make fresh versions and split-test them in your ad account.
Write one factual line about a feature. The actor delivers it exactly, so no review is invented.

steps_h2: How to make a spokesperson video with AI
steps_lead: Three steps. No casting, no studio, no filming.

steps.d: Add one clear photo. Keep the whole product in view with its shape and color visible.

steps.t: Pick an Actor and Share Your Idea
steps.d: Choose an actor and a scene that fit your audience. Share your video idea in one sentence.
Review the generated clip and download it. Add captions, price and offer text in your own editor.

faq.q: What is an AI spokesperson video?
faq.a: It is a video where an AI-generated actor holds your product and speaks one line to camera. You make it from a single product photo and use it as a brand-led ad.

faq.q: How does the actor speak my line?
faq.a: Write the line and choose an actor. The generated clip matches the actor's mouth to your words, so keep the line short for a calm delivery.

faq.q: Can I choose how the actor looks?
faq.a: Yes. Pick from the available adult actors, age ranges and scenes. Small differences between generated results are normal.
Handheld products show best: skincare, jewelry, snacks, drinks, pet and fitness items. Pick something with a shape or action that stays clear in one hand.

faq.q: Which platforms can I run the video on?
faq.a: Downloads have no watermark and can be used commercially. Run them on TikTok Ads, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or your product page, and label AI content where required.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is AI-generated, so never present them as a real buyer. Use the clip as a brand explanation and add an AI disclosure where the platform asks.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a UGC creator?
faq.a: A UGC creator films with your real product and can improvise. The AI actor speaks your exact line from a photo, so it is ready in minutes and costs far less.

faq.q: Are these videos cleared for commercial use?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are licensed for commercial use under our terms. Any captions, music or offers you add still need separate rights.

Direct-to-camera chest-up handheld phone framing, natural daylight, realistic skin. End with the strap relaxed in a loop with the studio behind him. Sound: clear speech and natural scene ambience; no music, text or logos.

m4.h2: Different Ways to Use Videos Made with AI Actors

uses.d: Spend less on creators, sets and crews. Pick an AI actor and a scene that fit the people you sell to. Make a new version of one ad in minutes and test which one gets the click.
Put an AI actor on your product page as the face of your brand. The actor holds the product and points out one key feature, so shoppers see it in use before they buy.
Keep your feeds full without booking a new shoot each week. Use one presenter across posts for a steady look, or switch actors and scenes for each audience on TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
Use an AI actor as a guide who shows your product one step at a time. Short clips can cover setup, sizing or daily use, so buyers have fewer questions after they order.
